scope: New game-specific console-origin projects with Android/iOS targets; separate rows for upstream-defined game targets sharing a repository.

projects.title: Super Mario Strikers Android Port
projects.status: The repository includes an Android 9+ arm64-v8a APK (v1.2.0) using Vulkan. It documents touch controls and gamepad support; no physical-device test is identified.
projects.summary: Android launcher and app layer for the native Super Mario Strikers port built on the community GameCube decompilation. The APK contains no game assets; players provide their own game data.
projects.strategy: Native port of the matching GameCube decompilation; shared game/runtime code is compiled for ARM64 and rendered through Vulkan, with Android-specific launcher and input integration.
projects.subtype: Android target of a decompilation-based native port

projects.title: Sonic R Android Edition
projects.platform: Windows PC build of the Sega Saturn game → Android
projects.status: Android releases are available through v1.2.7 (2026-10-04). The README documents SDL2, GLES2 and customizable touch controls; it does not identify a minimum Android version or named device test.
projects.summary: Native Android port of the PC Sonic R decompilation, which is based on the Saturn game. It requires the user's own PC game files and includes no retail assets; touch and gamepad input are documented.
projects.strategy: Android app and OpenGL ES 2.0 renderer built on the PC game's decompilation.
projects.subtype: Android port of a PC decompilation of a console-origin game

projects.title: RSDKv3 iOS — Sonic CD (2011)
projects.platform: Sega CD-derived Retro Engine v3 game → iOS/iPadOS (ARM64)
projects.status: An unsigned IPA is published; the README specifies ARM64 and iOS 13+, with touchscreen support on iPhone and iPad. It requires the user's own Data.rsdk; no physical-device test is stated.
projects.summary: iOS app for the RSDKv3 engine/game-code reimplementation based on the RSDKModding decompilation. No copyrighted game data is included; users must provide Data.rsdk from a legitimate Sonic CD copy and sideload the IPA.
projects.strategy: iOS engine port/reimplementation based on the RSDKv3 decompilation, packaged as an unsigned native ARM64 app.

Maintainer IPA releases

projects.title: Pokémon Emerald Dual Screen
projects.status: The latest published APK is v0.6.0 (2026-10-13). The README targets the AYN Thor and other dual-screen Android devices, but does not document a named physical-device test.
projects.summary: Native Android dual-screen mod/port built on the Pokémon Emerald decompilation. It adds a second-screen party, map, bag, settings and battle UI with touch or physical controls; the user supplies a USA or Europe Emerald ROM, and ROM hacks are unsupported.
projects.strategy: Android native port and dual-screen mod built from the pret/pokeemerald decompilation; no GBA emulator is used.
projects.subtype: Dual-screen Android port of a GBA decompilation

sources.label: Maintainer README: features and Android setup
Maintainer v0.6.0 APK release (2026-10-13)

projects.title: OpenCE Ports — Halo: Combat Evolved Android
projects.status: The official repository publishes Android release/debug ZIPs containing an APK. It requires Android 9+ and 64-bit ARM; the README lists the campaign and touch/gyro controls as working, while warning that 16 KB memory-page kernels cannot run it and some Vulkan shaders appear late. No named Android device is listed.
projects.summary: Android port on the existing OpenCE Ports repository, separate from its cataloged Switch target. Xbox build 2342 code from the decompilation is compiled for ARM; Vulkan is the default renderer with OpenGL ES 3 fallback. Users provide an Xbox ISO/XISO of any region, which is unpacked on first launch.
projects.strategy: Xbox decompilation compiled for native ARM64 with Android Vulkan/OpenGL ES graphics and app/input integration.
projects.subtype: Android target distinct from the same repository's Nintendo Switch target

projects.title: Gen1Recomp — Pokémon Red
projects.status: Gen 1 title support; release v0.3.89 (2026-10-15) includes Android APK and iOS IPA. The project does not identify physical phone/tablet testing.
projects.summary: Per-title mobile target of the hand-written Lua/LÖVE2D Gen1Recomp engine. It verifies and decodes the user's canonical US ROM on import and does not include game data or emulate the original handheld; the README identifies Gen 1 as the supported baseline.
projects.strategy: Hand-written Lua/LÖVE2D game and map-behavior reimplementation; game data, graphics and audio are decoded from a verified user-supplied ROM.
projects.subtype: Multi-title native reimplementation; separate record for this game
